` (no `if=` / `else-if=` sibling before it) fires E-CTRL-001. The `` + `let ` twin of ctrl-001-orphan-else-pos (legacy rhs-decl shape), so the bootstrap grades it. Severity (Error) is pinned by that legacy-shape twin; it is not asserted here because a bootstrap Diag carries no §34 severity yet.
rationale: §17.1.1 Normative Rules: "An element carrying `else` SHALL be immediately preceded at the same parent level by an element carrying `if=` or `else-if=`. The compiler SHALL reject any `else` attribute that does not satisfy this condition (E-CTRL-001)."
